title: Unified invoke adapter for schema-tolerant function calls with stream-resume and idempotency helpers
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: SDK users need a single, predictable helper for calling model-declared functions across Python/TS/Go that handles: schema validation/coercion, streaming responses (including partial function outputs), resumable streams after transient errors, idempotency for at-least-once semantics, and pluggable retry policies. Existing helpers are fragmented per-language and do not handle partially streamed function JSON payloads or mismatched/extra fields robustly.

Goal: Deliver a cross-language 'invoke adapter' with the following capabilities: 1) tolerant schema validation that accepts extra fields and coerces types where safe (e.g., string->int when numeric), 2) a streaming contract that emits 'function-chunk' events and replays buffered state when a stream resumes, 3) idempotency tokens and server-friendly deduplication hints, 4) configurable retry/backoff that understands streaming checkpoint boundaries to avoid duplicate side effects, and 5) clear ergonomic examples for Python, TypeScript, and Go.

Non-goals: Implementing server-side idempotency stores (server will accept idempotency hints only), building new model-side function execution guarantees, or changing the API wire format. This ticket ships client-side adapters and examples only.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-SDK adapter code shipped in python/ts/go packages with matching public API surface (invoke_with_schema or equivalent).
Adapter performs permissive schema coercion by default and provides strict mode opt-in.
Streaming helper emits chunk events and exposes a resume(token) method; resume correctly continues a stream after simulated network interruptions in tests.
Idempotency token is attachable per-call and documented; server-acknowledged duplicate responses are handled without user-level duplicate callbacks.
Comprehensive unit and integration tests (including fault-injection for mid-stream disconnects) with >90% coverage for adapter logic.
Three language samples (Python, TypeScript, Go) added to examples/sdk-examples repo and linked from SDK docs.
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Chen: Initial scoping + design doc created. Recommended default to permissive coercion to avoid breaking existing customers that pass integers as strings. Added checkpoints to streaming contract at JSON object boundaries.

2026-03-03 Daniel Park: Prototype in Python completed. Exposed `invoke_with_schema(schema, idempotency_key=None, strict=False, retry_policy=None)` and `StreamHandle.resume(token)` in the prototype. Observed edge-case where partial JSON fragments cross websocket frames; added incremental JSON parser to handle fragments.

2026-03-05 Priya Nair (Design): Reviewed CLI ergonomics for examples. Suggested adding a 'dry-run' mode to validate function schemas locally before invoking models — included as optional helper `validate_schema_locally()`.

2026-03-07 QA: Fault-injection tests demonstrate resume works in 98% of runs; failing cases correlated with extremely large single-token JSON outputs (>1MB chunk). Action: add chunk-size heuristics and fall back to buffering-to-disk for >512KB partials.

2026-03-09 Security: flagged idempotency header naming and recommended using `Idempotency-Key` with HMAC'd payload hint to avoid replay attacks. Ticket updated to include HMAC helper integration with KMS for Private customers. Security notes attached to Confluence doc.
2026-03-10 Daniel Park: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/5172. CI failing on TS build due to mismatched stream-iterator typings — assigning to TS lead.

2026-03-11 Thomas Nguyen (TS Lead): Fixed type signatures, added `AsyncGenerator<FunctionChunk>` export, and updated README examples. Also added automatic retry-policy heuristics tuned from benchmarks (recommended default: fast exponential up to 3 attempts for CONNECT-level errors, conservative for mid-stream resume to avoid duplicated effects).

2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Merged Python and TS adapters behind feature flag `invoke_adapter_v2`. Go adapter in review. Coordinating docs push and examples publication next week. Preparing migration guide for teams using raw function-calling patterns.
